story.title: Tailscale Traces Database Corruption to 16y/o SQLite WAL-Reset Bug

draft:
I've been following the story of Tailscale's recent database corruption issue. 
The root cause was a 16-year-old SQLite bug that affects WAL reset. 
This highlights the importance of thoroughly testing database interactions. 
What other old bugs are lurking in our codebases? 
#SQLite #DatabaseCorruption #SoftwareBugs
